messages:
Eli: Fig update! brought Fig (dachshund) to couch for a photo op and he insisted on perching on top of my monitor like it's a throne. posted: fig_sunhalo.jpg
Harper: that is peak authority. look at his little sun halo 31e :sunglasses: absolute CEO energy
Noor: monitor throne is a bold ergonomics choice. is he blocking your tab bar? :joy:
Eli: completely. had to move 3 tabs to refresh his nap spot. Fig is very particular about screen brightness.
Gabe: caption contest: "When the release goes smoothly so the dog becomes product manager" :tada: :dog:
Devon: "Fig: approves with paw-stamp" :paw_prints: seconded. also where do I apply to get that calm?
Harper: unsolicited tip: if you use a low-heat monitor setting he prefers it more. provenance: my neighbor's sausage dog.
Noor: ops-bot, hypothetical: pet day with desk cameo — any allergy check process? Fig is small and hypoallergenic-adjacent.
ops-bot: Reminder: Pet visits require People Ops approval. Please submit a Pet Visit request at least 72 hours in advance. Include carrier info for transit and an allergies check; dogs must have up-to-date vaccinations.
Eli: will submit. quick poll 5f3: Fig cameo preference? (1) quick lobby hello (2) desk cameo with mat (3) virtual cameo only (react with 1/2/3)
Gabe: reaction 2 from me. Fig deserves a mat.
Devon: 1 here 44b because my desk is already chaos
Harper: 2. also can we make a tiny scarf for him with the company logo? :thread: :heart:
Noor: Fig merch when?? :merch:
Eli: tiny scarf petition noted. thanks for the love for Fig everyone 60a
